subject.title: improve(qa): align Telegram proof and remove execution profiles

question: Should curated QA scenario membership remain runner-owned TypeScript policy, with scenario YAML limited to semantic execution facts and channel requirements?
rationale: This is a deliberate architecture and maintenance-boundary choice rather than a mechanical defect: it trades declarative catalog membership for explicit runner-local lists across CI and live transports.

options.title: Approve runner-owned selection
options.body: Accept the new boundary, relying on exact-membership and fail-closed tests to prevent CI and live-runner drift.

options.title: Keep declarative profile membership
options.body: Retain scenario-level membership metadata if maintainers want one catalog to remain the source of truth for curated runner selections.

options.title: Split the ownership refactor
options.body: Land the Telegram evidence corrections separately and defer the cross-runner selection migration for a narrower architecture discussion.

recommendation.title: Approve runner-owned selection
recommendation.body: Accept the new boundary, relying on exact-membership and fail-closed tests to prevent CI and live-runner drift.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa authored the linked problem report and the current QA-boundary implementation, so they are the closest available routing candidate for the intended invariant.
